content.title: Feedback Round: open primary posts
content.summary: A bounded host-controlled activity; app roles, publication and discussion remain with the host.
content.setup: The host supplies effective actors and resolved phase dates.
content.participant: Follow the prompt and submit one accepted contribution in each phase for which you are eligible.
content.completion: Closing this primary-contribution phase does not prohibit later host discussion or replies.
content.access: Primary contributions are shared immediately. Participant/reviewer/follower roles, replies and visibility beyond the activity audience are host-owned.

provenance.credit: Harmonomicon digital example; the runbook defines the selected software rules.
provenance.rights: Original example description. Rights to participant contributions are not specified by this package.

steps.prompt: Share a piece for open feedback.
